changes.name: SkyboundPetBoosts
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")

local function getEquippedPet(player)
 return workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name.."_Pet")
end

local function getBoost(player)
 local pet=getEquippedPet(player)
 if not pet then return 1 end
 local name=""
 local gui=pet:FindFirstChildOfClass("BillboardGui")
 local label=gui and gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
 if label then name=label.Text end
 if name=="Cloud Bunny" then return 1.25 end
 if name=="Sky Fox" then return 1.5 end
 if name=="Sun Cub" then return 2 end
 if name=="Storm Dragon" then return 3 end
 return 1
end

local lastAward={}

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  local pet=getEquippedPet(player)
  local character=player.Character
  local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if pet and root and pet:IsA("BasePart") then
   local target=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(4,1,3)
   pet.CFrame=pet.CFrame:Lerp(target,0.08)
  end
 end
end)

for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
 if obj:IsA("BasePart") and string.match(obj.Name,"^SkyCoin%d+$") then
  obj.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
   local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
   if not player then return end
   local now=os.clock()
   local key=tostring(player.UserId)..":"..obj:GetFullName()
   if lastAward[key] and now-lastAward[key]<1 then return end
   lastAward[key]=now

   local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
   local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
   if not coins then return end
   local boost=getBoost(player)
   local bonus=math.max(0,math.floor(boost-1))
   if bonus>0 then coins.Value+=bonus end
  end)
 end
end

print("Skybound pet boosts loaded")
